onboarding.demoTitle: You are looking at sample data
onboarding.demoDesc: The profiles, expenses and documents you see are made up, to show you how MyPlano works. Start with your own data whenever you like.
onboarding.confirmMessage: The sample profiles will be deleted with all their expenses, documents, the receipts stored in the browser, the Budget strategies and the fund and income settings. Language and app preferences stay. Right after, you can create your first profile.
onboarding.confirmMixed: Warning: besides the sample data there is data you added or changed. It will be permanently deleted too: all profiles, expenses, documents, receipts stored in the browser, Budget strategies and profile settings. To keep it, cancel and make a backup from Settings first.
onboarding.firstProfileDesc: A profile is a separate wallet (for example Personal, Home, Work) with its own balance, income, expenses and documents.
onboarding.firstProfileOrphans: There are already {n} expenses or documents waiting for a profile: once it exists you can assign them from Settings.
onboarding.firstProfileOrphansOne: There is already 1 expense or document waiting for a profile: once it exists you can assign it from Settings.

systemNotifications.title: Device notifications
systemNotifications.toggleDesc: Phone or computer alerts for deadlines due today, overdue and coming up
systemNotifications.deniedHelp: The browser blocked notifications for MyPlano. To unblock them open the site settings (icon next to the address, or phone Settings → Apps → MyPlano → Notifications), allow notifications and come back here.
systemNotifications.mutedNote: You muted all notifications: while they stay muted no alert reaches the device.

capability.background: On this device: alerts when you open the app and also while it is closed (background check about once or twice a day, decided by the system).
capability.installForBackground: On this device: alerts when you open MyPlano. Install the app (browser menu → Install app) to get them while it is closed too.
capability.iosAddToHome: On iPhone and iPad notifications work only with MyPlano added to the Home Screen (Share → Add to Home Screen, iOS 16.4 or later) and arrive when you open the app.
capability.iosOpenOnly: On iPhone and iPad alerts arrive when you open MyPlano or bring it back to the foreground: iOS does not allow checks while the app is closed without a server.
capability.openOnly: On this device: alerts when you open MyPlano or bring it back to the foreground (this browser does not check while the app is closed).
capability.bellOnly: This browser does not support system notifications: the bell and the in-app notification center still work.

systemNotifications.testBody: Notifications work: upcoming deadlines will show up here.
systemNotifications.testError: Could not show the test notification

archive.fallbackNotice: Files are temporarily stored in protected local IndexedDB storage.

errorBoundary.message: MyPlano hit an unexpected error and cannot show this screen.
errorBoundary.dataSafe: Your data has not been deleted. You can download a raw copy before reloading.

toast.storageFull: Storage full: your latest changes may not be saved. Export a backup.
toast.storageError: Saving failed: your latest changes may not be saved. Export a backup.

backup.orphans: {n} items without a profile: you can assign them from Settings.
backup.orphansOne: 1 item without a profile: you can assign it from Settings.
backup.reminder: We recommend exporting a backup at least once a month.
backup.attachmentsDesc: Receipts stored in the browser: {count} files, about {size} MB. The backup file will be larger; receipts in the connected PC folder are not included.
backup.confirmMessage: Backup from {date}: {profiles} profiles, {expenses} expenses, {documents} documents, {attachments} attachments. All current data will be replaced (interface preferences are kept).
backup.errInvalidJson: The file is not valid JSON. No data was changed.
backup.errInvalidFormat: The file is not a recognised MyPlano backup. No data was changed.
backup.errNewerVersion: This backup comes from a newer MyPlano version: update the app before restoring it.
backup.errMissingProfiles: The backup has no profile list. No data was changed.
backup.errInvalidData: The backup contains invalid or damaged data. No data was changed.
backup.errInvalidAttachments: The attachments in the backup are damaged. No data was changed.
backup.errWriteFailed: Not enough storage space: the restore was cancelled and your previous data is intact.
backup.errAttachmentsFailed: Could not save the attachments: no data was changed.
backup.errReadFailed: Could not read the selected file.
backup.errRestoreFailed: Storage full: the restore failed and not all previous data could be put back. Download the copy of your previous data now and import it again after freeing space.
backup.legacyWarning: Older backup version: some settings (strategies, hidden notifications, mute) will go back to their defaults.
